mapper.select: select sum(Ipv_Done_Last_Year) as ipvDoneLastYearTotal, sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) as ipvPlannedInvTotal from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State = 7 and Ipv_Declare_Year = #{year} and P_Id in (select P_Id from Pre_Project where deleted = false and state = 7)
select sum(Ipv_Planned_Pay) from Inv_Plan_Year where P_Id = #{pId} and (Ipv_Declare_Year >= #{startYear} and Ipv_Declare_Year <= #{endYear})

select sd.D_Name as ipvDName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal, pro.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, con.Con_Name as conName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, cany.c_name as ipvCName, mn.* from Inv_Plan_Year mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Department sd on mn.Ipv_D_Id = sd.D_ID left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Ipv_Id left join SYS_Company cany on mn.Ipv_C_id = cany.c_Id where mn.Ipv_Id = #{ipvId}

select sd.D_Name as ipvDName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal, pro.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, con.Con_Name as conName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Inv_Plan_Year mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Department sd on mn.Ipv_D_Id = sd.D_ID left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Ipv_Id where mn.Ipv_Id = #{ipvId}
select ims.* from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims where ims.Ipv_Id = #{ipvId} order by ims.Ims_Month asc
select ims.* from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims where ims.Ipv_Id = #{ipvId} order by ims.ims_year, ims.ims_month

select ipy.Ipv_Scheduled_Plan as ipvScheduledPlan, ipy.Ipv_Planned_Investment as ipvPlannedInvestment, ipy.Ipv_Planned_Pay as ipvPlannedPay, p.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, sd.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName from Inv_Plan_Year ipy left join Pre_Project p on p.P_Id = ipy.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = p.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department sd on sd.D_Id = p.P_Competent_Department where ipy.P_Id = #{pId} and ipy.Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy')

select P_Name as pName, (case when ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total is null or ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total = 0 then 0 else (select sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) from Inv_Complete_Month where Ipv_Id = ipy.Ipv_Id) / ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total end) as completeRate from Inv_Plan_Year ipy left join Pre_Project pro on ipy.P_ID = pro.P_ID where Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') order by completeRate desc limit #{size}

select Ims_Month as invMonth, sum(Ims_Planned_Inv) as invPlanAmt from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') group by Ims_Month order by Ims_Month asc

select Icm_Reporting_Month as invMonth, sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) as invAmt from Inv_Complete_Month ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') group by Icm_Reporting_Month order by Icm_Reporting_Month asc

select dep.D_Name as dName, res.invMonth, res.invAmt from Sys_Department dep right join (select pro.P_Competent_Department as dId, ims.Ims_Month as invMonth, sum(ims.Ims_Planned_Inv) as invAmt from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = ipy.P_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') group by pro.P_Competent_Department, ims.Ims_Month order by pro.P_Competent_Department, ims.Ims_Month asc) res on res.Did = dep.D_Id

select (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State = 7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy')) as yearPlanInv, (select sum(Ims_Planned_Inv) from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ms left join Inv_Plan_Year py on py.Ipv_Id = ms.Ipv_Id where Ipv_State = 7 and py.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') and cast(to_char(now(), 'mm') as int) >= Ims_Month) as currentMonInv, (select sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) from Inv_Complete_Month ms left join Inv_Plan_Year py on py.Ipv_Id = ms.Ipv_Id where Ipv_State = 7 and py.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') and cast(to_char(now(), 'mm') as int) >= Icm_Reporting_Month and (Icm_State = 7 or cast(transfer_status as int) = 7)) as completeInv

select ipy.Ipv_Scheduled_Plan as ipvScheduledPlan, ipy.Ipv_Planned_Investment as ipvPlannedInvestment, ipy.Ipv_Planned_Pay as ipvPlannedPay, p.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, sd.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName from Inv_Plan_Year ipy left join Pre_Project p on p.P_Id = ipy.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = p.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department sd on sd.D_Id = p.P_Competent_Department where ipy.P_Id = #{pId} and ipy.Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y')

select P_Name as pName, (case when ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total is null or ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total = 0 then 0 else ((select sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) from Inv_Complete_Month where Ipv_Id = ipy.Ipv_Id) / ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total) end) as completeRate from Inv_Plan_Year ipy left join Pre_Project pro on ipy.P_ID = pro.P_ID where Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y') order by completeRate desc limit #{size}

select Ims_Month as invMonth, sum(Ims_Planned_Inv) as invPlanAmt from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y') group by Ims_Month order by Ims_Month asc

select Icm_Reporting_Month as invMonth, sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) as invAmt from Inv_Complete_Month ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y') group by Icm_Reporting_Month order by Icm_Reporting_Month asc

select dep.D_Name as dName, res.invMonth, res.invAmt from Sys_Department dep right join (select pro.P_Competent_Department as dId, ims.Ims_Month as invMonth, sum(ims.Ims_Planned_Inv) as invAmt from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = ipy.P_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y') group by pro.P_Competent_Department, ims.Ims_Month order by pro.P_Competent_Department, ims.Ims_Month asc) res on res.Did = dep.D_Id

select (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State = 7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y')) as yearPlanInv, (select sum(Ims_Planned_Inv) from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ms left join Inv_Plan_Year py on py.Ipv_Id = ms.Ipv_Id where Ipv_State = 7 and py.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y') and cast(date_format(now(), '%c') as unsigned) >= Ims_Month) as currentMonInv, (select sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) from Inv_Complete_Month ms left join Inv_Plan_Year py on py.Ipv_Id = ms.Ipv_Id where Ipv_State = 7 and py.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y') and cast(date_format(now(), '%c') as unsigned) >= Icm_Reporting_Month and (Icm_State = 7 or cast(transfer_status as unsigned) = 7)) as completeInv

SELECT a.YEAR yearTime, a.v totalPayment, b.n planAmount, a.type type FROM ( SELECT to_char ( Pay_Create_Time, 'yyyy' ) YEAR, sum( pay_apply ) v, '1' type FROM Con_Pay GROUP BY to_char ( Pay_Create_Time, 'yyyy' ) ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ipv_declare_year, sum( ipv_budget_total ) n, '1' type FROM Inv_Plan_Year b GROUP BY ipv_declare_year ) b ON a.YEAR = b.ipv_declare_year UNION SELECT b.ipv_declare_year yearTime, a.v totalPayment, b.n planAmount, b.type type FROM ( SELECT to_char ( Pay_Create_Time, 'yyyy' ) YEAR, sum( pay_apply ) v, '1' type FROM Con_Pay GROUP BY to_char ( Pay_Create_Time, 'yyyy' ) ) a RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT ipv_declare_year, sum( ipv_budget_total ) n, '1' type FROM Inv_Plan_Year b GROUP BY ipv_declare_year ) b ON a.YEAR = b.ipv_declare_year

select ipy.Ipv_Scheduled_Plan as ipvScheduledPlan, ipy.Ipv_Planned_Investment as ipvPlannedInvestment, ipy.Ipv_Planned_Pay as ipvPlannedPay, p.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, sd.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName from Inv_Plan_Year ipy left join Pre_Project p on p.P_Id = ipy.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = p.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department sd on sd.D_Id = p.P_Competent_Department where ipy.P_Id = #{pId} and ipy.Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy')

select P_Name as pName, (case when ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total is null or ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total = 0 then 0 else ((select sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) from Inv_Complete_Month where Ipv_Id = ipy.Ipv_Id) / ipy.Ipv_Budget_Total) end) as completeRate from Inv_Plan_Year ipy left join Pre_Project pro on ipy.P_ID = pro.P_ID where Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') order by "completeRate" desc limit #{size}

select Ims_Month as invMonth, sum(Ims_Planned_Inv) as invPlanAmt from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') group by Ims_Month order by Ims_Month asc

select Icm_Reporting_Month as invMonth, sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) as invAmt from Inv_Complete_Month ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') group by Icm_Reporting_Month order by Icm_Reporting_Month asc

select dep.D_Name as dName, res.invMonth, res.invAmt from Sys_Department dep right join (select pro.P_Competent_Department as dId, ims.Ims_Month as invMonth, sum(ims.Ims_Planned_Inv) as invAmt from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims left join Inv_Plan_Year ipy on ipy.Ipv_Id = ims.Ipv_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = ipy.P_Id where ipy.Ipv_State = 7 and ipy.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') group by pro.P_Competent_Department, ims.Ims_Month order by pro.P_Competent_Department, ims.Ims_Month asc) res on res."dId" = dep.D_Id

select (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State = 7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy')) as yearPlanInv, (select sum(Ims_Planned_Inv) from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ms left join Inv_Plan_Year py on py.Ipv_Id = ms.Ipv_Id where Ipv_State = 7 and py.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') and cast(to_char(now(), 'mm') as int) >= Ims_Month) as currentMonInv, (select sum(Icm_Monthly_Investment) from Inv_Complete_Month ms left join Inv_Plan_Year py on py.Ipv_Id = ms.Ipv_Id where Ipv_State = 7 and py.Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') and cast(to_char(now(), 'mm') as int) >= Icm_Reporting_Month and (Icm_State = 7 or cast(transfer_status as int) = 7)) as completeInv
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P_Id,Ipv_Declare_Year ORDER BY ipv_State_Time DESC) AS rn FROM Inv_Plan_Year where ipv_State=7 ) t WHERE t.rn = 1
select distinct mn.${value} from Inv_Plan_Year mn where mn.${value} is not null order by mn.${value} asc
select distinct pp.${value} from Inv_Plan_Year mn left join pre_project pp on mn.p_id = pp.p_id where pp.${value} is not null order by pp.${value} asc

select distinct prod.${value} from Inv_Plan_Year mn left join pre_project pp on mn.p_id = pp.p_id left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pp.P_Competent_Department where prod.${value} is not null order by prod.${value} asc

select distinct ${value} as dbValue from Inv_Complete_Month mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Department psd on psd.D_Id=pro.P_Department left join SYS_Department sd on mn.Icm_D_Id=sd.D_ID left join Inv_Plan_Year ipv on ipv.Ipv_Id=mn.Ipv_Id left join Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims on ims.Ipv_Id=ipv.Ipv_Id and ims.Ims_Month=mn.Icm_Reporting_Month

mapper.sql: left join ( select ipv2.Ipv_Id, LISTAGG(d.D_Name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.D_Id) as dep_names from Inv_Plan_Year ipv2 join SYS_Department d on INSTR(',' || ipv2.p_competent_departments || ',', ',' || d.D_Id || ',') > 0 group by ipv2.Ipv_Id ) depAgg on depAgg.Ipv_Id = mn.Ipv_Id

left join ( select ipv2.Ipv_Id, GROUP_CONCAT(d.D_Name ORDER BY d.D_Id SEPARATOR ',') as dep_names from Inv_Plan_Year ipv2 join SYS_Department d on FIND_IN_SET(d.D_Id, ipv2.p_competent_departments) group by ipv2.Ipv_Id ) depAgg on depAgg.Ipv_Id = mn.Ipv_Id
